Nunu|jgl.identity: Magic damage tank who specializes in snowball ganks and objective control. Consume (Q) bites a monster or minion (big true damage and healing) or a champion, Biggest Snowball Ever! (W) rolls a snowball that grows and knocks up on impact, Snowball Barrage (E) slows, then roots enemies hit several times, and Absolute Zero (R) channels a freezing zone that slows before a massive explosion. His passive speeds up Nunu and a nearby ally.
Nunu|jgl.playstyle: Gank and objective jungler. Nunu crosses the map in his snowball to gank any lane and secures epic monsters thanks to his Q.
Nunu|jgl.early_game: Clear with Q (very strong on monsters) and E. Gank from level 3: W from far away, knock-up, then E to root. Use Q on Scuttles and epic monsters to secure them.
Nunu|jgl.level_2: Biggest Snowball Ever! (W) on the most common path. It grows as it rolls: the farther it comes from, the more it hurts. First gank possible from level 2-3.
Nunu|jgl.level_3: Snowball Barrage (E). Slows, then roots: W → E is your full gank.
Nunu|jgl.level_6: Absolute Zero: a channel that heavily slows, then explodes. Cast it when enemies can't get out of the zone (after your knock-up or in an objective fight). You can end it early for less damage.
power_spikes: Level 6: Absolute Zero in objective fights.
First completed item: a solid tank.
Nunu|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear with Q, then frequent snowball ganks: Nunu can gank any lane quickly. Control Scuttles and use Q to secure Void Grubs (around 8 minutes), dragons and Baron. Invade with your laners: your Q on enemy camps is very fast.
Nunu|jgl.trading: Ganking: W from far away → knock-up → E to root → Q. Teamfighting: W to engage, E to slow, R when enemies can't get out. Give up on it against champions who interrupt your R channel.
threats: CC that interrupts your Absolute Zero.
Ivern, the only clearly unfavorable matchup according to the data.
Duels against very aggressive early-game junglers.
mistakes: Throwing the snowball too close (little damage and easy to dodge).
Channeling R when the enemy can easily walk out of it.
Forgetting to use Q to secure epic monsters.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: He'll invade you: gank and secure objectives with Q.
matchup_notes.Viego: Root him with E when he dives.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you in early duels: avoid him, gank on the other side.
matchup_notes.Sylas: He can steal your ultimate: don't use R when he can take it back.
matchup_notes.Ivern: He protects his allies: aim for targets out of his range.

Nunu|jgl.mid_game: Ganks and objective control. Nunu is very strong at securing epic monsters with Q.
Nunu|jgl.late_game: Engage with W, control with E and R. Protect your carries and secure Baron with Q.
Nunu|jgl.ahead: Gank nonstop, take objectives and force fights.
Nunu|jgl.behind: Secure objectives with Q and play with your team.
Nunu|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to gank every lane with your snowball and control epic monsters with Consume.
Nunu|jgl.final_tip: Throw your snowball from far away: the longer it rolls, the bigger it gets and the more it hurts.
